summary_en: 10,000,000 shares (2.99% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired at upper limit of ¥200.0B via open-market purchase contract from 3 August 2026 to 24 March 2027 (trade basis). Acquired shares to be cancelled to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice regarding decision on matters related to acquisition of own shares
translation_en_brief: HOYA Corporation announced on 31 July 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire up to 10,000,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 2.99% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury), for a maximum total outlay of ¥200.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchase under an investment discretionary contract from 3 August 2026 through 24 March 2027 (on a trade-settlement basis). The company intends to cancel the acquired shares. The stated rationale is to strengthen shareholder returns while improving capital efficiency and enabling flexible capital allocation decisions. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 317,525 treasury shares against 334,520,495 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
